THEOLOGICAL CLIMAX OF 1 MEQABYAN — the triple-formula 'Abraham is my friend; Isaac is my favored one; Jacob is the beloved of my heart; in them I have been praised, says God who is all-powerful.' 'Abraham my friend' (Abraham wedajē) directly echoes James 2:23 ('Abraham believed God... and he was called the friend of God'), itself drawing on Isaiah 41:8 ('Abraham my friend' — ahavi / philos mou) and 2 Chronicles 20:7. The TRIPLE-PATRIARCH STRUCTURE is standard liturgical idiom, but the SPECIFIC GRADIENT (friend → favored → beloved) appears to be a Meqabyan composition. The pairing with 36:43 (Genesis 15:6 'Abraham believed God and it was reckoned to him as righteousness' — the same verse cited by Paul at Romans 4:3 and James at James 2:23) REPLICATES THE EXACT NEW TESTAMENT ABRAHAM-TYPOLOGY: faith-reckoned-as-righteousness + friendship-with-God.

HELLENISTIC-DEITY CATALOG — the most striking single piece of Hellenistic-era evidence in 1 Mq: Baal-of-Canaan + Dagon-of-the-Philistines + APOLLON (Greek Apollo) + ARṬEMADES (Greek Artemis with Geʽez -des ending) + SERAPION (Hellenistic-Egyptian Serapis). The pairing of Apollo + Artemis + Serapis is the STANDARD IMPERIAL-ROMAN-ERA civic pantheon of the eastern Mediterranean. The presence of SERAPIS is especially DIAGNOSTIC: the Serapeum of Alexandria was destroyed by Christians in 391 CE, after which the cult quickly declined. This catalog therefore most plausibly reflects a setting BEFORE c. 400 CE when Serapis-worship was still a live religious competitor — or alternatively a literary preservation of an earlier-stratum tradition. Either way, the verse is a TERMINUS-A-QUO anchor for Meqabyan's earlier-stratum composition layer (per Horovitz 1905 + CROSS_REFERENCE_APPENDIX §61 widened-dating).

DOCTRINAL CAPSTONE of 1 Meqabyan: 'the dead shall rise; those who did good works shall go to eternal life; and that those who did evil shall, at the resurrection of the dead, go to eternal punishment. But the righteous who did good works shall reign with him forever.' Direct parallel to John 5:29 (resurrection-of-life / resurrection-of-judgment) + Daniel 12:2 (those who awake to everlasting life / shame and everlasting contempt). Closes with DOUBLE-AMEN (አሜን፥ አሜን) — the standard EOTC book-closing doxological formula marking the decisive end of 1 Meqabyan.

'Men of Macedonia, do not boast! Amalekites, do not stiffen your neck! For there is God who shall avenge himself against you. Though you exalt yourself to heaven, you shall descend to Sheol' (vv. 1-2). MACEDONIA + AMALEKITES paired warning. The image of EXALTING-TO-HEAVEN-AND-DESCENDING-TO-SHEOL is a direct echo of ISAIAH 14:13-15 (Lucifer's boast-and-fall — 'I will ascend into heaven... yet thou shalt be brought down to hell, to the sides of the pit') AND of MATTHEW 11:23 / LUKE 10:15 (the WOE AGAINST CAPERNAUM: 'and thou, Capernaum, which art exalted unto heaven, shalt be brought down to hell'). The Macedonia-naming is DIAGNOSTICALLY POST-CLASSICAL: 'Men of Macedonia' specifically as an addressed-people implies the Macedonia-Christian-mission-horizon (Acts 16:9-10 Paul's Macedonian-vision); the Amalekites-naming preserves the Hebrew-Bible enemy-typology. The pairing compresses biblical-and-Christian-era enemy-prides into one warning.

'And Abraham BELIEVED IN GOD; AND THEREFORE IT WAS RECKONED TO HIM AS RIGHTEOUSNESS; and his hope on earth was fulfilled — his wife Sarah, even after she had grown old, bore the son Isaac' — DIRECT CITATION OF GENESIS 15:6 ('And he believed in the LORD; and he counted it to him for righteousness'), THE SAME VERSE cited by Paul at ROMANS 4:3 ('Abraham believed God, and it was counted unto him for righteousness') AND by James at JAMES 2:23 ('And the scripture was fulfilled which saith, Abraham believed God, and it was imputed unto him for righteousness: and he was called the Friend of God'). The pairing of this verse with seed 36:22 ('Abraham my friend' triple-formula) REPLICATES THE EXACT NEW TESTAMENT ABRAHAM-TYPOLOGY: faith-reckoned-as-righteousness (Gen 15:6 / Rom 4 / Jas 2) + friendship-with-God (Isa 41:8 + 2 Chr 20:7 + Jas 2:23). The Meqabyan-Pauline-Jacobean Abraham-typology is one of the trilogy's strongest direct-NT parallels.
